market.summary: 示範資料：上線後由每日排程自動更新。
market.fed: 上線後由 AI web search 更新 Fed 利率預期。
drivers: 示範：實際排程將整理昨晚漲跌原因。

companies.name: Oracle
companies.what: Oracle Cloud、資料庫、企業軟體、AI GPU Cloud
companies.why: OCI AI Cloud 高速成長、企業資料庫黏著度高、RPO 龐大
companies.method: Forward EPS × 17–21x；因高 Capex / 負 FCF 給折價
companies.risk: AI Capex 回報不佳、負 FCF、債務／融資壓力

companies.name: NVIDIA
companies.why: AI Compute 龍頭，CUDA 生態系＋高階 GPU 定價權強
companies.method: Forward EPS × 19–23x；同時觀察 FCF 與 AI Capex 強度
companies.risk: Hyperscaler Capex 大降、CUDA moat 弱化、ASIC 取代加速

companies.name: Micron
companies.why: HBM＋DRAM 三寡占，AI Memory 長期需求強
companies.method: 正常化 EPS 約 85–105 × 11–12x；不採高峰 EPS
companies.risk: HBM 需求下降、DRAM 供給失控、ASP 崩跌

companies.name: Broadcom
companies.why: 同時吃 AI ASIC、資料中心網路與高 FCF 軟體現金流
companies.method: Forward EPS × 20–23x；搭配 FCF Yield 檢查
companies.risk: Hyperscaler 客戶集中、ASIC 專案流失、VMware 成長放緩

companies.name: TSMC
companies.what: 先進製程、CoWoS、AI 晶片製造
companies.why: GPU、ASIC 誰贏都可能受益，是平台型 AI 曝險
companies.method: 2027 EPS × 21–24x；搭配 FCF、ROIC、製程領先度
companies.risk: AI/HPC 需求下降、製程領先消失、地緣政治

companies.name: Synopsys
companies.what: EDA、晶片 IP、Ansys 多物理模擬
companies.why: 晶片越複雜越需要設計／模擬工具，週期性較低
companies.method: Forward EPS × 27–31x；搭配 FCF、Ansys 整合效益
companies.risk: Ansys 整合失敗、EDA 成長放緩、競爭惡化

companies.name: Microsoft
companies.why: 企業客戶黏著度極高，AI 可直接嵌入既有軟體收費
companies.method: Forward EPS × 25–29x；看 Azure 成長與 FCF
companies.risk: Azure 成長放緩、AI Capex ROIC 過低、Copilot 變現不足

companies.name: Meta
companies.why: AI 已直接提高推薦與廣告效率，不只是未來故事
companies.method: Forward EPS × 21–24x；重點看 Capex 對 FCF/ROIC 的侵蝕
companies.risk: AI Capex 暴增但變現跟不上、廣告成長放緩

companies.name: Amazon
companies.why: AWS 是 AI 商業化平台，自研晶片與雲端生態完整
companies.method: Forward EPS × 24–29x；搭配 AWS 增長與 FCF
companies.risk: Capex 吞噬 FCF、AWS 失速、AI 投資報酬下降

companies.name: Alphabet
companies.why: AI 從模型、TPU 到 Cloud 與 Search 幾乎全棧自研
companies.method: Forward EPS × 23–27x；觀察 Search economics 與 FCF
companies.risk: AI 侵蝕搜尋經濟模型、Capex 過高、監管

companies.name: Vertiv
companies.what: 資料中心電力、UPS、液冷、散熱
companies.why: AI 機櫃功耗上升，電力與散熱成為核心瓶頸
companies.method: Forward EPS × 28–33x；看訂單成長與 FCF
companies.risk: AI 資料中心建設降溫、競爭／毛利率下降

companies.name: Arista Networks
companies.why: AI cluster 越大，東西向流量與 Ethernet 需求越高
companies.method: Forward EPS × 35–42x；高品質但倍數已高
companies.risk: Microsoft/Meta 集中度、NVIDIA Networking 競爭

companies.name: Cadence
companies.why: 晶片複雜度提高，EDA 用量與價格提升
companies.method: Forward EPS × 35–40x；搭配 backlog 與 FCF
companies.risk: 估值過高、EDA 成長低於預期

companies.name: KLA
companies.why: 2nm、GAA、HBM 越複雜，越不能容忍缺陷
companies.method: Forward EPS × 30–35x；搭配 FCF Yield、ROIC
companies.risk: WFE 下行、Process-control intensity 下降

companies.name: Applied Materials
companies.what: 半導體製造設備、材料工程
companies.why: GAA、HBM、DRAM、先進封裝四線受益
companies.method: Forward EPS × 25–29x；用正常化 WFE 週期檢查
companies.risk: Memory/Foundry Capex 同時下滑、出口限制

companies.name: Lam Research
companies.why: NAND 層數、HBM、DRAM 製程複雜度提高
companies.method: Forward EPS × 28–32x；正常化 Memory Capex
companies.risk: Memory Capex 週期反轉

companies.name: Marvell
companies.why: Hyperscaler 自研晶片＋高速互連長線受益
companies.method: Forward EPS × 38–45x；要求成長持續兌現
companies.risk: ASIC 專案流失、客戶集中、AVGO 競爭

companies.name: Astera Labs
companies.why: PCIe 6/7 channel loss 增加＋rack-scale AI 互連需求
companies.method: Forward EPS × 45–55x＋DCF；高成長需更大安全邊際
companies.risk: Scorpio 失敗、Retimer 競爭、Hyperscaler Capex 下修

companies.name: AMD
companies.why: NVIDIA 之外最有規模的 AI GPU / Server CPU 選擇
companies.method: Forward EPS × 35–42x；需更大安全邊際
companies.risk: Instinct 執行不及預期、NVIDIA 差距擴大

companies.name: SanDisk
companies.why: AI Storage / Data Center SSD＋NBM 改善週期
companies.method: 正常化 EPS 115–130 × 11–12x；不採 NAND 高峰獲利
companies.risk: NAND ASP 下跌、供給失控、NBM 無法降低週期

companies.name: ASE Technology
companies.what: 半導體封裝／測試、先進封裝
companies.why: AI/HBM/Chiplet 都增加高階封裝需求
companies.method: 中週期 EPS × OSAT 合理倍數；不給 TSM 等級 premium
companies.risk: Advanced Packaging 利用率下降、Capex 過度、價格競爭

notes: Seed data. Daily automation will refresh market data and company analysis.
